title: Chips pe ab RED WARNING? SC ka bada order #shorts

source.title: 3S and Our Health Society v. Union of India & Ors. (2026 INSC 1275 · MA 1177/2025 in W.P.(C) No. 437/2024)
source.issuer: Supreme Court of India (J.B. Pardiwala & K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.)

hook.caption: Har packet ek silent shart hai — ab chips, biscuits aur cold drinks ke FRONT par Supreme Court ne alag warning labels order kar diye!
hook.tts: हर पैकेट अब एक silent इम्तिहान है — क्योंकि आपकी chips, biscuits और cold drink पर Supreme Court ने सीधे front warning अनिवार्य कर दी है.

doc.name: 3S & Our Health Society v. Union of India
doc.caption: Official SC Judgment (131 pages, 26 Nov 2026): Informed food choice ko Article 21 Right to Health ka hissa maana gaya.
doc.tts: यह 26 November 2026 का Supreme Court का 131 page का judgment है, जिसने साफ कहा कि सही food label आपका Article 21 का हक है.

points.title: Total Sugar & Saturated Fat
points.quote: The FSSAI shall ensure that the FoPNL treats “total sugars” and “saturated fat”, rather than “added sugar” and “added fat”, as the nutrients-of-concern, alongside “salt”, in alignment with its own long-standing consensus existing prior to the DGI, 2024.
points.decoded: Added sugar loophole band — total sugars, saturated fat aur salt count honge
points.caption: Point 1: Sirf 'added sugar' aur 'added fat' nahi — ab TOTAL sugars, saturated fat aur salt gina jayega! Par packet ke front par yeh dikhega kaise — star rating ya kuch aur?
points.tts: पहला point. अब सिर्फ़ added sugar और added fat नहीं, बल्कि total sugars, saturated fat और salt गिना जाएगा. पर packet के front पर यह दिखेगा कैसे — star rating या कुछ और?

points.title: 3 Separate Warning Hexagons
points.quote: The FSSAI shall ensure that the FoPNL provides for a separate hexagon for each nutrient-of-concern, each containing the words “High Fat”, “High Sugar”, “High Salt”, respectively alongside their corresponding pictograms, rather than a single combined hexagon.
points.decoded: Twist: Combined label reject! 'High Fat', 'High Sugar', 'High Salt' ke alag hexagons
points.caption: Point 2 (Twist): Yahi sabse bada twist hai! Court ne single combined warning reject kar di — ab 'High Fat', 'High Sugar', 'High Salt' ke liye alag-alag pictogram hexagons lagenge!
points.tts: यही सबसे बड़ा twist है! Court ने single combined warning reject कर दी — अब High Fat, High Sugar और High Salt के लिए अलग-अलग pictogram hexagons लगेंगे!

points.title: 4%–5% Front Panel Size
points.quote: The FSSAI shall fix the size of each hexagon in proportion to the principal display panel of the package, such that each hexagon occupies not less than 4%/5% of that panel as evidenced by international practices, unless explicit reasons to the contrary exist as stated in Section 18(2)(a)(ii).
points.decoded: Har hexagon front pack ka kam se kam 4%–5% hissa gherega + 10 weeks mein report
points.caption: Point 3: Chhota fine-print trick bhi band! Har warning hexagon front panel ke kam se kam 4%–5% size ka hoga — aur FSSAI ko 10 weeks mein progress affidavit dena hai.
points.tts: तीसरा point. छोटा fine-print भी बंद! हर warning hexagon front panel के कम से कम 4 से 5 percent size का होगा — और FSSAI को 10 weeks में report देनी है.

lines: Pack palat kar chhota table padhna nahi padega
FSSAI ko ~4 months mein draft rule laana hoga
Kya har snack par yeh warning honi chahiye? Comment karo
asar.caption: Aap par asar: FSSAI ko lagbhag 4 months mein rule final karna hai aur school ke 50m ke andar junk ads pehle se banned hain. Aap batao — kya har packet par yeh warning zaroori hai? Share karo!
asar.tts: आप पर असर. FSSAI को लगभग 4 महीने में rule final करना है. आप comment में बताओ — क्या हर packaged snack पर यह front warning ज़रूरी है? अपने family group में ज़रूर share करो.
